question: A pipe has a right prism shape with an equilateral triangle base of side 6 cm and length 40 cm. Find its water-holding capacity.
solution:
**Given:**

Side of equilateral triangle base = 6 cm

Length of prism = 40 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 / 4) × side²

Volume of prism = Base Area × Length

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area
